Hi there ,
Here I have some riddle game which was released by me and my friend about 2 weeks ago:
 http://theroomz.freehost.pl 
The main objective is to pass through all rooms (something kinda 'escape the room game'). Always You need to find the password to go to the next room. Password is hidden, ciphered, or You need to make up one using hints, which You can find in each room.
There is a RULES thingy (in MAIN MENU), where You can read the instructions.
I would really appreciate Your thoughts and opinions about that game.
Thanks in advance

Stachu,
Awesome work on this game, I always love the puzzles.
I've seen a lot of non-english forums talk about it (i just googled it when i got stuck on level 3).
